entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker. Just send me the label.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your order, could I get your name or order number?
The order number is VF78-99-B02. I'm in a hurry.
Understood. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order was delivered on December 15th. So I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It doesn't matter. I tried to do this online over a week ago, but your whole system was down. I just need to return it.
I'm sorry to hear that. You mentioned the system was down. Can you recall the date you tried to make the return?
Around Christmas Eve. I got a 'website error' message and couldn't print the label. It was a complete waste of time. I even took a screenshot.

Thank you for that detail. Let me check our system status for that day... Yes, I can confirm we had a known outage that day. My apologies, it must have been frustrating to see the system down when you were trying to get that processed.
Let me just check the policy here for you... Okay, according to our knowledge base, all VeloFit products have a 90-day return window.
Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for you right now. No problem at all.
Okay, good. Send the label to my email.
I've just sent it. You should receive the prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Once we get the band back, we'll issue a full refund. Can I help with anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
